title: Scheduled maintenance – NBN services in Penrith and Glebe (NSW)
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance may interrupt some NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW) between 12:00 am and 7:00 am AEDT on Wed 21 Oct 2026. A network provider will be migrating services during this window.

cause.reason: Planned network provider migration of services

updates.content:
We will be conducting scheduled network work with a provider that may affect NBN services in the Penrith and Glebe areas (NSW). The maintenance window is Wed 21 Oct 2026 from 12:00 am to 7:00 am AEDT. During this time, some services may experience brief interruptions.

We will monitor the work and provide updates if anything changes. If your service remains offline after 7:00 am AEDT, please power-cycle your modem/router and contact us.
